from: June book, night 24 (Two Mothers and a Baby)
p1: Two mothers came to King Solomon with one little baby boy. Each mother said, “This baby is mine!”
No one else had been in the house to see. So how could the king know who the real mother was?
Solomon gave them a wise test. It would show which mother loved the baby most. The baby stayed safe the whole time.
p2: The real mother’s heart ached for her son. She cried, “Please give her the baby. Just keep him safe!” So Solomon gave the baby to the real mother. Everyone saw that Heavenly Father had made Solomon wise.
Tonight, give a hug to someone who loves you. Heavenly Father gave you people who love you, and He loves you too.
old: Two mothers came to King Solomon. They were arguing about a baby! Both of them said, “This baby is MINE!” They needed Solomon to help them.
Solomon thought carefully. Then he said something shocking: “Bring me a sword! I’ll cut the baby in half — half for each mother.”
The REAL mother cried out, “NO! Don’t hurt the baby! Give him to her — just don’t hurt him!” The other woman said, “Yes, cut him in half!”
Solomon smiled. He knew the real mother right away! A real mother would rather lose her baby than see him hurt. Solomon gave the baby back to his real mommy. Everyone saw how WISE Solomon was!
